primary_result: All 625 frozen independent OTS validation scenes and all 1,875 nested variants completed with zero failure. The official Haze4K ConvIR-B baseline met the global OTS-competence prerequisite in 609/625 scenes, with Wilson 95 percent lower bound 0.958822 above 0.80. Only 48/625 scenes met the frozen tau-aligned local-mismatch indicator, for prevalence 0.0768 and Wilson 95 percent interval [0.058414, 0.100357]. Because even the upper bound was below the preregistered 0.20 material margin, the frozen OTS synthetic-outdoor local-mismatch claim failed.
gate_reasons: The parent INCONCLUSIVE tuple and supplement-only authorization matched exactly, as did the 625-scene list, official checkpoint, model source, model layers and selected OTS pairings.

The repair preserved the parent content resize, reflect-extended only the model canvas to the official graph's minimum safe support, cropped prediction before every scientific measurement, and recomputed all 625 scenes without pooling parent outcomes.
Complete coverage passed: 625 independent scenes, 1,875 nested variants and zero failed scenes.
Global OTS competence passed: 609/625 scenes improved full-image MSE in at least two of three severities; Wilson 95 percent interval was [0.958822, 0.984182].
The primary tau-aligned scene-mismatch prevalence was 48/625 = 0.0768 with Wilson 95 percent interval [0.058414, 0.100357], whose upper bound was below the frozen 0.20 materiality margin.
Severity-level mismatch rates were 0.1456 at beta 0.04, 0.0752 at beta 0.10 and 0.0432 at beta 0.20; the required scene rule remained at least two of three severities.

Median true low-minus-high relative correction was negative at every severity, so the aggregate direction was more correction in high-tau than low-tau regions rather than the preregistered high-tau under-restoration pattern.
competing_explanation: The initial research concern may arise in real nonuniform haze, a different degradation construct, different region labels, or a different baseline, but it is not materially prevalent under this qualified OTS tau field and frozen official-baseline definition. The rotated-tau control remains descriptive rather than causal, and the result does not establish that tau causes restoration behavior.
limitations: This is L1 development-screening evidence for one fixed official Haze4K ConvIR-B instance on RESIDE OTS synthetic outdoor optical thickness only.
The FAIL stops the current OTS tau-aligned mismatch continuation and authorizes no threshold revision, module design, training or same-question retry.
Secondary relative-harm ratios can become large where low-tau input error is near zero; they are descriptive and did not replace the frozen primary scene indicator.
The result does not rule out local restoration mismatch under real nonuniform haze, independently validated region labels, another degradation variable, or another model instance.
No SOTS outcome, Haze4K outcome, NH-HAZE, confirmation, canary or locked-test evidence was accessed, and no training occurred.
